finalText:
**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs, both from the bump:

- `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed in [options.js](src/core/options.js).
- `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled, in [retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js).

The rest of the warning wall is deprecation noise from the new deps, unrelated to these two.
